title: S01 Diagonal Corner Cabinet
description: Original freestanding corner base with a nominal 0.9m by 0.9m countertop footprint, 0.9m high, with a diagonal fixed door, true storage cavity and shaped shelf. The diagonal front frame slightly projects past the nominal top footprint; placement must use the actual complete geometry envelope with an explicit installation clearance. The two returns accommodate separate same-family cabinets, not a strict seamless module. Individual complete top; not a seamless fitted-kitchen system. Independent editable components in a fixed static pose, with no motion, load or physics claim.
